name: context-harness
description: Context management for Claude Code: fold completed tool results into one-line pointers at compaction instead of summarizing, keep the project's intent and status files current, and Jev judgment gates for announced-but-undone turns, secret files under other providers, conditional instructions and what to fold. Folding needs no key; the Jev gates are auto by default and turn on once a key is in place and you consent (/jev-consent).

keepRecentTurns.title: Turns kept verbatim
keepRecentTurns.description: Tool results from this many most recent turns are never folded.

minFoldChars.title: Smallest result to fold (characters)
minFoldChars.description: Smaller results stay; folding them saves little and costs a read_coordinate call when needed.

keepErrorsUnder.title: Keep errors shorter than (characters)
keepErrorsUnder.description: Short errors stay so the model does not repeat the same mistake.

keepTools.title: Tools never folded
keepTools.description: Comma-separated tool names whose results always stay.

foldAtPercent.title: Fold by itself at context % (0 = off)
foldAtPercent.description: After a turn, fold once the context window is at least this full.

minSavedPercent.title: Fold by itself only when it saves at least %
minSavedPercent.description: Each fold rebuilds the prompt cache once, so small gains are skipped.

intentFile.title: Intent file
intentFile.description: The agent's reading of what you want, with your own words as its source. Used only while it exists; empty turns it off.

phaseFile.title: Status board file
phaseFile.description: Where the work is, what is next, what needs you. Must be current before a fold. Used only while it exists; empty turns it off.

episodeDir.title: Episode log folder
episodeDir.description: Dated logs of what happened. Must have a new entry before a fold. Used only while it exists; empty turns it off.

jev.title: Jev (every judgment gate)
jev.description: on (default): the gates send to Jev as each one's mode says. off: nothing is sent to Jev by any gate, whatever its mode; folding runs by rule alone.

stopGate.title: Stop gate (announced-but-not-done turns)
stopGate.description: auto (default): active once a key is in place, jev is on, and you consented with /jev-consent; off until then. off: nothing. shadow: Jev judges each turn end and only records it; the last paragraph (scrubbed) is sent to TypeSafe. active: a judged announcement makes the model continue.

toolGate.title: Tool gate (secret files, non-Anthropic providers)
toolGate.description: off: nothing. shadow: records tool calls that touch secret files or print secrets. active: refuses them when the session is served by a provider other than Anthropic, and refuses writes to this plugin's own files. Nothing is sent to TypeSafe.

toolJev.title: Tool gate: Jev judgment (external sessions)
toolJev.description: auto (default): active once a key is in place, jev is on, and you consented with /jev-consent; off until then. off: nothing. shadow: in sessions served by a provider other than Anthropic, Jev classifies each call the floor let through (open, standard, restricted, custom) from its path or command and records it; the scrubbed path or the command's first 200 characters are sent to TypeSafe, never file contents. active: calls judged restricted or custom are refused.

stopThreshold.title: Stop gate threshold
stopThreshold.description: Jev's probability of 'announce' at or above which a turn counts as announcing work.

timeoutMs.title: Jev timeout (ms)
timeoutMs.description: A Jev call that takes longer is dropped and the gate does nothing.

stopCap.title: Stop gate calls per session
stopCap.description: Jev calls the stop gate may make in one session.

toolThreshold.title: Tool gate threshold
toolThreshold.description: Jev's probability of restricted plus custom at or above which a call counts as sensitive.

toolCap.title: Tool gate calls per session
toolCap.description: Jev calls the tool gate may make in one session; each target is asked once.

providerTrust.title: Provider trust
providerTrust.description: auto: decide from the session (first-party only with an Anthropic credential, no proxy, no custom CA, no Bedrock/Vertex/Foundry, and an anthropic.com endpoint). external: always treat the session as served by another provider.

trustedProxies.title: Trusted local proxies
trustedProxies.description: Comma-separated host:port of local proxies known to forward to Anthropic only (for example 127.0.0.1:9100).

instructions.title: Conditional instructions
instructions.description: auto (default): active once a key is in place, jev is on, and you consented with /jev-consent; off until then. off: nothing. shadow: for each prompt you type, Jev judges which fragments' conditions hold and records it; the prompt (scrubbed, first 600 characters) and the fragments' conditions are sent to TypeSafe, never their bodies. active: matching fragments are appended to that prompt once, and pinned fragments go at the end of the system prompt.

fragmentsDir.title: Fragments folder
fragmentsDir.description: Folder of *.md fragments with when:, keywords: and pin: frontmatter. ~ means your home folder.

instructionThreshold.title: Conditional instructions threshold
instructionThreshold.description: Jev's probability that a fragment's condition holds at or above which it is attached.

instructionCap.title: Conditional instructions calls per session
instructionCap.description: Jev calls the conditional instructions may make in one session.

foldJev.title: Fold relevance
foldJev.description: auto (default): active once a key is in place, jev is on, and you consented with /jev-consent; off until then. off: nothing. shadow: at each compaction Jev judges which large earlier tool results the current request still needs, beside what the policy folded, and records it. active: a result Jev says is finished with is folded even inside the recent window, and one it says is still needed is left whole, at every compaction, automatic ones included; a Jev that does not answer within the timeout leaves the fold to the rule. Your last prompt (scrubbed), each result's tool and target, and the scrubbed opening of each result (at most 300 characters) are sent.

foldThreshold.title: Fold relevance: still needed from
foldThreshold.description: With fold relevance active, a result Jev gives at least this probability of still being needed stays whole. Measured with jev-1.14.0 on one bug-fix request: results the fix needed got 0.38-0.85, the others 0.00-0.26.

foldCap.title: Fold relevance calls per session
foldCap.description: Jev calls the fold judgment may make in one session (24 results per call).

apiKey.title: TypeSafe API key
apiKey.description: Kept in secure storage. Without it, the plugin's .env (TYPESAFE_API_KEY=) or the TYPESAFE_API_KEY environment variable is used.

instructionFilter.title: Instruction filter (CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md)
instructionFilter.description: auto (default): active once a key is in place, jev is on, and you consented with /jev-consent; off until then. off: nothing. shadow: each time the instruction files load, records which chunks are loaded twice and, with a key, Jev's reading of which chunks every request needs and which repeat earlier ones; the scrubbed instruction text, and for chunks Jev would defer your prompts (first 600 characters), are sent to TypeSafe. active: chunks loaded twice byte for byte are left out, and once Jev has read the files, so are the chunks it reads as repeating earlier ones or needed only for some work; the always-kept rules (identity, language, approval, shell, git, keys, browser) never are.

webRead.title: Web reading (web_read)
webRead.description: auto (default): active once a key is in place, jev is on, and you consented with /jev-consent; off until then. off: nothing. shadow: after each WebFetch call, the same page is fetched and Jev judges which of its blocks answer the call's prompt; what web_read would have returned is recorded, WebFetch's answer is unchanged. active: adds the web_read tool, which returns only the blocks of a page that answer the question, verbatim, and keeps the whole page for read_coordinate. The page's text and your question, scrubbed, are sent to TypeSafe.

webReadCap.title: Web reading calls per session
webReadCap.description: Jev requests web reading may make in one session (a long page takes tens).

webTimeoutMs.title: Block judgment timeout (ms)
webTimeoutMs.description: One Jev request of web reading or kept fold blocks that takes longer is dropped; its blocks count as unjudged.

foldBlocks.title: Kept blocks at a fold
foldBlocks.description: auto (default): active once a key is in place, jev is on, and you consented with /jev-consent; off until then. off: nothing. shadow: at each compaction, Jev judges which blocks of the largest folded results your last prompt still needs, and records it. active: those blocks stay verbatim under the pointer; the rest is in read_coordinate. The results' text and your last prompt, scrubbed, are sent to TypeSafe.

foldBlocksCap.title: Kept-block calls per session
foldBlocksCap.description: Jev requests the kept-block judgment may make in one session.

foldBlocksResults.title: Results judged per fold
foldBlocksResults.description: The largest folded results judged for kept blocks at each compaction.

foldBlocksBudgetMs.title: Kept-block time per fold (ms)
foldBlocksBudgetMs.description: How long a compaction waits for the kept-block judgment; results still being judged then are folded to a pointer alone.

browserRoute.title: Browser routing
browserRoute.description: auto (default): active once a key is in place, jev is on, and you consented with /jev-consent; off until then. off: nothing. shadow: for each prompt you write, records whether it needs a web browser operated (keywords, else Jev) and which installed tool would be used. active: such a prompt gets one instruction naming the tool to use, in the order ego-browser, Aside, agent-browser, Playwright, then a CDP tool you name; with none installed, you are told once in 14 days. Your prompt (scrubbed, first 600 characters) is sent to TypeSafe when no keyword decides.

browserThreshold.title: Browser routing threshold
browserThreshold.description: Jev's probability that a request needs a browser operated, at or above which it is routed.

browserCap.title: Browser routing calls per session
browserCap.description: Jev calls browser routing may make in one session.

browserBlocked.title: Browser tools never suggested
browserBlocked.description: Comma-separated: ego, aside, agent-browser, playwright, cdp. A tool your settings or hooks block belongs here, so it is never suggested.

browserCdp.title: CDP tool to suggest last
browserCdp.description: How to name a Chrome DevTools Protocol tool you use (for example an MCP server), suggested when none of the others is installed. Empty: none.

imageMaxPx.title: Downscale Read images over (pixels; 0 = off)
imageMaxPx.description: A Read of a PNG or JPEG larger than this on its long side reads a smaller copy instead. An image costs about width*height/750 tokens and a fold cannot reach it, so a large screenshot is paid for on every request until the session ends.
